plugins.name: bmad-workflows
plugins.description: BMAD agents + workflows + QA skills + slash commands + BMAD runtime guards (agent scope, output consistency, config priority). Full BMAD layer in one plugin.

plugins.name: test-enforcement
plugins.description: Pre-write quality gates: spec tags, quality checklist (9 rules), fixture/helper prereqs, security reminder, run-then-fixme.

plugins.name: cost-control
plugins.description: Cost optimization: block duplicate Read calls to avoid wasted cache_read tokens. Compact-aware with auto-allow escape valve.

plugins.name: qa-context
plugins.description: UserPromptSubmit roadmap reading enforcement: injects reminder to read docs/roadmap/ before implementing features or writing tests.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright setup check (SessionStart) + test automation orchestration + QA skill doc preloading (UserPromptSubmit). Covers: playwright.config, @playwright/test, tests/ structure, Rule #6 P0/P1/P2 split, service/factory discipline.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: Session lifecycle (start/stop/cleanup/logger-init/logger-tool) + Langfuse telemetry & scoring (score-detector + push-score + accuracy-efficiency). Single langfuse-helper.js (no duplication). Granular SKIP_LANGFUSE=1 disables Langfuse push only — session logs vẫn chạy.
